crossRefs.note: He said of his father, and of his mother, ‘I have not seen him.’ He didn’t acknowledge his brothers, nor did he know…
Why do you kick at my sacrifice and at my offering, which I have commanded in my habitation, and honor your sons above…
He who loves father or mother more than me is not worthy of me; and he who loves son or daughter more than me isn’t…
But he answered him who spoke to him, “Who is my mother? Who are my brothers?”
His mother and his brothers came, and standing outside, they sent to him, calling him.
Jesus said to her, “Woman, what does that have to do with you and me? My hour has not yet come.”
You are my friends, if you do whatever I command you.
to whom we gave no place in the way of subjection, not for an hour, that the truth of the Good News might continue with…
But from those who were reputed to be important—whatever they were, it makes no difference to me; God doesn’t show…
For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision amounts to anything, nor uncircumcision, but faith working through love.
However, I consider those things that were gain to me as a loss for Christ.
Yes most certainly, and I count all things to be a loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus, my Lord…
where there can’t be Greek and Jew, circumcision and uncircumcision, barbarian, Scythian, bondservant, or free person…
I command you in the sight of God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, and the chosen angels, that you observe these things…
Lay hands hastily on no one. Don’t be a participant in other people’s sins. Keep yourself pure.
My brothers, don’t hold the faith of our Lord Jesus Christ of glory with partiality.
But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceful, gentle, reasonable, full of mercy and good fruits…
It is the spirit who gives life. The flesh profits nothing. The words that I speak to you are spirit, and are life.

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Therefore we know no one after the flesh from now on. Even though we have known Christ after the flesh, yet now we know him so no more.
translations.bsb: So from now on we regard no one according to the flesh. Although we once regarded Christ in this way, we do so no longer.
translations.kjv: Wherefore henceforth know we no man after the flesh: yea, though we have known Christ after the flesh, yet now henceforth ➔ know we him no more.
translations.asv: Wherefore we henceforth know no man after the flesh: even though we have known Christ after the flesh, yet now we know him so no more.
